description: Deterministic plain-language astrological glossary for AI compatibility report generation.

items.Dina Porutham: Dina Porutham evaluates day-to-day vitality and health harmony between birth stars.
items.Gana Porutham: Gana Porutham assesses temperamental alignment and social attitudes between the couple.
items.Mahendra Porutham: Mahendra Porutham evaluates family growth, progeny welfare, and enduring attachment.
items.Stree Deergha Porutham: Stree Deergha Porutham checks lunar distance to promote the wife's wellbeing and prosperity.
items.Yoni Porutham: Yoni Porutham checks biological affinity and mutual attraction between animal archetypes.
items.Rasi Porutham: Rasi Porutham examines the Moon sign distance for emotional and domestic accord.
items.Rasyadhipathi Porutham: Rasyadhipathi Porutham evaluates friendship between planetary rulers of the Moon signs.
items.Vashya Porutham: Vashya Porutham measures natural interpersonal amenability and mutual respect.
items.Rajju Porutham: Rajju Porutham evaluates longevity and mangalya protection across spinal and bodily stations.
items.Vedha Porutham: Vedha Porutham verifies the absence of mutually afflicted or repellent star pairings.
items.Varna Koota: Varna Koota evaluates spiritual compatibility and ego alignment.
items.Vashya Koota: Vashya Koota measures mutual psychological attraction and natural amenability.
items.Tara Koota: Tara Koota evaluates mental health, fortune, and wellbeing across nakshatra cycles.
items.Yoni Koota: Yoni Koota assesses biological and physical affinity through animal archetypes.
items.Graha Maitri Koota: Graha Maitri Koota assesses intellectual friendship and outlook between Moon sign rulers.
items.Gana Koota: Gana Koota evaluates temperamental harmony across Deva, Manushya, and Rakshasa temperaments.
items.Bhakoot Koota: Bhakoot Koota measures emotional bonding, financial stability, and family welfare.
items.Nadi Koota: Nadi Koota evaluates Ayurvedic physiological and nervous system balance across Vata, Pitta, and Kapha.
items.Mangal Dosha: Mangal Dosha evaluates Mars placement from Lagna and Moon for temperamental friction and domestic adjustment.
items.Dosha Samya: Dosha Samya assesses whether Mars afflictions between charts are mutually balanced or un-neutralized.
